name: status-page
title: Status Page
description: 灵感来自 Eventbrite 与 Linear 状态页，原创实现。总体横幅、可用率条、响应时间折线和事件时间线。

files.content:
"use client" import { graphLinePath } from "@/components/ui/scroll-svg-graph" import { UptimeBars, buildUptimeDays, type UptimeService, type UptimeStatus } from "@/components/ui/uptime-bars" import { usePrefersReducedMotion } from "@/hooks/use-prefers-reduced-motion" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" export interface StatusIncident { id: string title: string time: string status: UptimeStatus } export interface StatusPageProps { services?: UptimeService[] samples?: number[] incidents?: StatusIncident[] className?: string } const LEGEND: { status: UptimeStatus; label: string; tone: string }[] = [ { status: "ok", label: "正常", tone: "bg-emerald-500" }, { status: "degraded", label: "降级", tone: "bg-amber-400" }, { status: "partial", label: "部分故障", tone: "bg-orange-500" }, { status: "major", label: "重大故障", tone: "bg-rose-500" }, { status: "maintenance", label: "维护", tone: "bg-sky-400" }, ] const DEFAULT_SERVICES: UptimeService[] = [ { id: "api", name: "接口", days: buildUptimeDays(2) }, { id: "web", name: "站点", days: buildUptimeDays(4) }, { id: "mail", name: "邮件", days: buildUptimeDays(6) }, ] const DEFAULT_SAMPLES = [42, 48, 45, 70, 66, 58, 52, 49] const DEFAULT_INCIDENTS: StatusIncident[] = [ { id: "1", title: "接口响应变慢", time: "2026-10-18 09:20", status: "degraded" }, { id: "2", title: "邮件队列维护完成", time: "2026-10-12 02:00", status: "maintenance" }, ] function banner(services: UptimeService[]) { const latest = services.flatMap((service) => service.days.at(-1)?.status ?? "ok") if (latest.includes("major")) return "重大故障" if (latest.includes("partial")) return "部分服务发生故障" if (latest.includes("degraded")) return "部分服务性能下降" return "所有系统运行正常" } function StatusPage({ services = DEFAULT_SERVICES, samples = DEFAULT_SAMPLES, incidents = DEFAULT_INCIDENTS, className }: StatusPageProps) { usePrefersReducedMotion() const max = Math.max(...samples, 1) const path = graphLinePath(samples.map((value) => (value / max) * 100)) const message = banner(services) return (

{message}

过去 90 天的服务记录。

响应时间

近期公告

    {incidents.map((incident) => (

  1. {incident.title}

    {incident.time}

    2. ))}
    {LEGEND.map((item) => (
  • {item.label}
    • ))}
) } export { StatusPage }
